environment.timeout_scope: Harness timeout, not a measured performance acceptance bound.

source_hash_scope: Committed compiled source for the optimized worker run; native runs have their separate source scopes below. Hashes cover local working-tree bytes of committed files changed by the implementation commits, plus lockfile and toolchain.
concurrent_merge: Between native qualification and the committed optimized worker run, d6f5479b75c847bdc76be91c999fe532653161d5 merged unrelated CLI work. Its only lockfile change adds the already-resolved env_filter package as a dependency of rspice-cli. No core source, core dependency version or core feature changed in that merge.

implementation.admission: Native constant-coefficient CCCS, with validated aligned storage, terminal/control bounds, finite gain and an existing physical controlling-branch owner. Behavioral, POLY and stateful forms retain their separate provider predicates.
implementation.equations: A CCCS driven by an ideal-source branch participates in both finite-current and impulse incidence. Exact fraction-free elimination derives the weighted laws annihilating charge-port and complete source-current incidence columns. Other controlling MNA branches remain ordinary finite constitutive coordinates, including inductor state and rates.
implementation.shared_kernel: PSS and event preparation share the pre-existing bounded exact-elimination and rational-projection code. The PSS adapter retains its prior coefficient diagnostics and tests. Ordinary event populations retain their connected-component path.
implementation.startup: For projected events, a compiled linear voltage seed satisfies prescribed and voltage-controlled constraints while retaining free incoming coordinates. Newton still solves nonlinear charge, impulse and algebraic equations and audits original charge/flux/KCL. Continuous, operating-point and integrated-reference certification do not substitute this projected seed.
implementation.state: Current conservation and voltage seed mappings are prepared once per PreparedEventCircuit and shared with its event topologies. Source/output/control bindings authenticate reuse; time-dependent values remain separately evaluated. Finite-rate references share each omitted original KCL row budget using the prepared weights.
implementation.observations: Native I(F) is available in ordinary transient, physical events and restart. Derived F-current impulse traces copy the controlling solved-branch impulse with the authored gain; finite controlling branches retain zero impulse in this event class. Observation fanout remains atomic with accepted event publication.
implementation.resources: Exact preparation, retained mappings, trial samples, solves and derived impulse bindings include bounded storage accounting. Cancellation and resource failures retain typed outcomes with the original caller budget. Whole-run allocation/failure/latency qualification remains open.
implementation.physical_family_census: 14 of 38 families admitted, with instance predicates; 24 other families and remaining admitted-instance restrictions still require implementation/disposition.

coverage.final_focused_scope: Eight current_control-selected native unit tests pass after the final iterator-only correction: six new operator/provider cases and two existing regressions. These overlap the broader selections and are not eight additional distinct tests.
coverage.unit_contracts: Five direct operator tests cover signed charge transfer, weighted floating-component KCL across node permutations, coupled source-current feedback, exact rank below binary64 product precision, malformed controls, cancellation and resource limits. One prepared native-provider test covers finite inductor controlling state and its differentiated output.
coverage.shared_kernel_scope: 39 PSS state tests pass after the mechanical shared-kernel extraction; strict library Clippy also passes.
coverage.gp_positive_matrix: 72 public calls in two new tests. Across all three dialects and both polarities, smooth GP forcing exercises six OP runs, six UIC runs, six checkpoints and six resumes, with independent instantaneous base charge/current and delayed collector-current laws. The RC matrix also spans gains -2 and +0.5: twelve coarse runs, twelve fine runs, twelve checkpoints and twelve resumes.
coverage.ordinary_transient_matrix: Three dialects, negative current gain and selected I(F1) output, checked against independent resistor/source-current equations without physical events.
coverage.native_integration_scope: 121 tests across 11 targets, zero failures/ignores; includes existing controlled-source, AC/HB, periodic response, multiplicity, line, checkpoint, cancellation and resource/fault regressions.
coverage.wasm_scope: 28 tests across four targets, zero failures/ignores on committed optimized core source in a Chrome dedicated worker. The ordinary current-selection target is native-only in this batch. Enabling veriloga-wasm-jit is not external-model/JIT qualification.
coverage.transient_unit_scope: 588 passed; one existing diagnostic ignored. The direct operator/provider tests overlap this selection and are not additional distinct tests.
coverage.existing_ignored_diagnostic: engine::transient::residual::tests::diffamp_one_step_map_spectral_radius_probe: diagnostic probe over the diffamp regression deck; pre-existing ignore, unchanged by this batch.

resolved_development_failures: Moved imports and sibling-module visibility were corrected after compile diagnostics. Strict Clippy requested enumerating a component member list; the same component/member order is retained, and focused native tests, final Clippy and committed optimized tests follow that correction.

Xyce UIC exhausted 20 event Newton iterations while the damped collector/base voltage trial had reached only about 1.687 V / 0.5905 V of the required 2 V / 0.7 V. The new constraint-consistent trial seed repairs this case without increasing iteration limits or changing conservation tolerances.

The initial RC fixture applied its 2e-6 V waveform gate on a 4 ps request. Xyce startup integration produced a 7.141e-6 V peak error. The 4 ps result remains an explicit coarse case; all dialects must reduce error by a factor below 0.7 at 1 ps, where the original 2e-6 V gate and unchanged finite-current/impulse gates apply. The measured Xyce fine error is about 4.480e-7 V.
remaining: All C00-C14 packages remain open. Native CCCS physical events are delivered; this does not close C03d.1 or C03.
CCVS requires its voltage-impulse/inductor-current-jump descriptor where applicable. It remains a missing implementation, not a completed exclusion.
Circuit-dependent, switched, stateful and other unsupported behavioral expressions remain C03d.1 work; C03d.2-.5 retain their other native/stateful/external family and instance predicates.

C03c still requires separate Weil feedback/private-node oracles, further parameter/temperature/scaling and rejection/restart cases, whole-run allocation/memory, inner-solve cancellation, configuration and measured performance gates.

Cross-component event-current cancellation is conservatively retained unless structural charge-component identity or absence of weighted algebraic rows certifies cancellation. No rounded coefficient equality is used as proof.
No new live ngspice/Xyce comparison or full-crate test run is claimed.
